observations: Check 1 is the one thing I will not rule on alone, because the architect's rule and the evidence point different ways. The rule says a difference from main's bun.lock is a defect of this round; the evidence says the difference is two workspace version strings that main's own package.json already declares, that this branch never touched either manifest, and that both trees install under the frozen lockfile. Reverting them would make this pull request's lockfile disagree with the manifests it ships beside, which is the state main is in today. I am recording it rather than failing the round on it, and have asked the architect to rule - the issue is past its round cap, so a round spent on two inert lines is worth a decision rather than a reflex.

The store package needs an encoding the harness does not give it. A pod cluster created with `initdb` and no locale lands on SQL_ASCII, and that is enough to red one store row at any head; if a later round needs the store package green on a pod, the lane's cluster has to be created with UTF8 rather than the row changed.
